typography.instructions: Use elegant editorial serif for all headings. Use clean, highly-readable sans-serif for body text. Ensure typography feels like a premium boutique food brand. Avoid generic 'Inter' for headings. Use tracking-tight for large headings.

colors.instructions: USE ONLY these two brand colors and their shades. AVOID rainbow colors, excessive gradients, or multiple accent colors. Text should ideally be a very deep shade of Terracotta/Brown for high contrast on Ivory, or Warm Ivory on Terracotta backgrounds.

visual_enhancers.borders: Restrained, 1px solid in subtle shades of Terracotta or Ivory.
visual_enhancers.shadows: Subtle, ambient shadows only. Avoid harsh drop shadows.
visual_enhancers.whitespace: Generous spacing. Use 2-3x more padding than standard templates (e.g., p-12, p-20) to create a luxurious feel.
visual_enhancers.textures: Clean and solid. Avoid cheap gradients.
visual_enhancers.shapes: Rectangular or clipped frames (arches, pill shapes) for images to evoke a premium editorial feel.

components.hero: Large kinetic hero with full-width Terracotta background. Ivory 'AMYA' serif logo. Headline 'GOOD FOOD BEGINS WITH TRUST.' with signature on-load masked line-by-line reveal.
components.logo: Terracotta background, ivory 'AMYA' serif lettering, 'ARTISANAL FOODS' in small widely-spaced letters beneath. Original simple SVG logo mark for favicon.
components.marquee: One slow editorial marquee with elegant typography.
components.product_cards: Premium product detail pages and catalog. NO cheap product cards. Spotlight photography, clean layout, restrained borders.
components.bento_grid: Aligned bento grid for categories or 'Our Story' section.
components.announcement_bar: Editable announcement bar at the top.

layouts.general: Mobile-first, fully responsive. Awwwards Site-of-the-Day level structure.
layouts.spacing: Use 'bento' grid modes where applicable, ensuring perfect alignment and tension. Do not use generic centered bootstrap columns.

motion.interactions: Framer-motion scroll-reveals + micro-interactions. Premium, purposeful motion. AVOID excessive/distracting animations.
motion.special: One subtle parallax/3D hero moment. Kinetic masked reveals for text.

accessibility.contrast: Ensure sufficient contrast between Terracotta and Ivory, and deep brown text on Ivory.
accessibility.testing: All interactive and key informational elements MUST include a 'data-testid' attribute (kebab-case, role-based).

media.style: Real product photography treated deliberately (spotlight, clipped frames).

libraries.components: shadcn/ui (highly customized to look bespoke and cardless)

instructions_to_main_agent: Pre-launch mode is ACTIVE: Do NOT build a functional checkout. Add bookings, enquiries, and WhatsApp contact buttons instead.
Build 'AMYA Live Press' page with 4 steps: Choose Oil, Book Slot, Watch Live on WhatsApp, Receive Order.
Pages required: Home, Shop, Oils, Pickles, Cashew Brittles, AMYA Live Press, Our Story, Contact, Transparency Promise, About, plus Secure Admin Dashboard.
Strict color rule: Do NOT use any other colors besides shades of Terracotta (#B94F40) and Warm Ivory (#FFF5E8).
Do NOT make the UI look like a generic grocery-store template. Avoid too many promo banners.
Products have states: Available / Coming Soon / Temporarily Unavailable.
Ensure 'ARTISANAL FOODS' is always below the 'AMYA' serif logo, widely spaced.
DO NOT use a fully transparent header over hero images if it affects readability. Since hero is full terracotta, header can share the color or use a subtle separator.
Build the dashboard cleanly using Shadcn, maintaining brand fonts but optimized for data density.
UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT: Avoid generic, 'on distribution' outputs. Create depth through layered design and optical alignment.
Never center align the entire app container.
Use modern pill-shaped or sharp buttons with micro-interactions.
Do not use generic AI emojis for icons. Use lucide-react or @phosphor-icons/react.
Prioritize reusing UI components from src/components/ui.
Ensure generous spacing—designs should not feel cramped.
Apply `data-testid` to all interactive elements for testing.
